title: Discovery → Jira Agent
summary: From a messy client call to reviewed Jira tickets in 2 minutes — every requirement traced back to the transcript.
problem: Requirements get lost between the discovery call and the backlog; contradictions with the spec surface too late.
solution: LangGraph agent: extracts requirements with verbatim quotes, checks them against the spec via RAG (new / duplicate / conflict / unclear), writes stories; a human approves before idempotent Jira writes.
result: Evals with a pass threshold in CI, LangSmith traces and cost per run, dry-run Jira preview in the public demo.
